'''Zachary Mullock''' (born 1984/1985)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/politics/new-jersey/jeff-van-drew-zack-mullock-debate-south-jersey-20261023.html|title=‘Daddy Trump,’ data centers and the Iran war: Here are the highlights from Jeff Van Drew’s debate with Zack Mullock|first=Aliya|last=Schneider|date=October 23, 2026|website=Inquirer.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.capemaycity.com/mayorzacharymullock|title=Official Website of Cape May New Jersey|website=Cape May New Jersey}}</ref> is an American politician. He is the representative-elect for [[New Jersey's 2nd congressional district]] in the [[United States House of Representatives]].

Mullock has a bachelor's from [[Mount St. Mary's University (Maryland)|Mount Saint Mary's University]] and a [[Master of Business Administration]] from [[Saint Joseph's University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ocnjsentinel.com/zack-mullock-running-in-the-democratic-primary-for-congress/|title=Zack Mullock running in the Democratic primary for Congress ‣ Ocean City Sentinel|date=April 8, 2026}}</ref> He succeeded Chuck Lear as the mayor of [[Cape May, New Jersey|Cape May]] on January 1, 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://newjerseyglobe.com/congress/cape-may-mayor-prepping-congressional-bid-in-nj-2/|title=Cape May mayor prepping congressional bid in NJ-2|first=Joey|last=Fox|date=February 4, 2026}}</ref> As the mayor of Cape May, he oversaw the construction of a new fire house, library, community center, and theater, as well as a new police station.<ref>{{Cite web |last=EvoGov.com |title=Official Website of Cape May New Jersey |url=https://www.capemaycity.com/MayorZacharyMullock |access-date=2026-11-04 |website=Cape May New Jersey |language=en}}</ref>

Mullock ran for the [[United States House of Representatives]] for {{ushr|NJ|2}} in the 2026 elections. Endorsed by the [[Blue Dog Coalition|Blue Dog PAC]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bluedogdems.com/zack-mullock/|title=Mayor Zack Mullock|website=https://bluedogdems.com/}}</ref>, he defeated Republican incumbent [[Jeff Van Drew]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://6abc.com/post/nj-primary-2026-zack-mullock-wins-democratic-nomination-us-house-new-jerseys-2nd-congressional-district/19223439/|title=Zack Mullock wins Democratic nomination for U.S. House in New Jersey's 2nd Congressional District|date=June 3, 2026|website=6abc Philadelphia}}</ref>
